milestones.text: spent their first proper evening on {hobby} and lost track of the hour
milestones.post: Looked up and it was dark. Good sign, I think.

milestones.text: learned the basics of {hobby} from a very patient friend
milestones.post: Thank you for your patience. I will need more of it.

milestones.text: set aside an evening for {hobby} and actually kept to it
milestones.post: Said I would, and I did. Small victory.

milestones.text: finished their first real session of {hobby} wanting another straight away
milestones.post: One more. Then bed. Probably.

milestones.text: cleared a corner at home that is now, officially, for {hobby}
milestones.post: This corner belongs to the game now.

milestones.text: made it through a whole first week of {hobby} without giving up
milestones.post: One week in. Still here.

milestones.text: made time for {hobby} three evenings in a row
milestones.post: Three nights running. I may have a habit.

milestones.text: stopped needing to ask how {hobby} works and just got on with it
milestones.post: No questions tonight. Just playing.

milestones.text: had their first evening of {hobby} where everything seemed to click
milestones.post: Tonight it all made sense. Saving this feeling.

milestones.text: talked a friend into trying {hobby}
milestones.post: Recruited one. The movement grows.

milestones.text: caught themselves thinking about {hobby} on the walk home
milestones.post: Still turning it over in my head. Cannot stop.

milestones.text: found a regular time for {hobby} and stuck to it for a month
milestones.post: A month of the same night, same time. Ritual.

milestones.text: surprised an old hand at {hobby} with how far they had come
milestones.post: Got a raised eyebrow from a veteran. I will take it.

milestones.text: realised they now have strong opinions about {hobby}
milestones.post: I have opinions now. Strong ones. Ask me.

milestones.text: spent a whole rainy day on {hobby} and called it well spent
milestones.post: Rain all day. Did not mind one bit.

milestones.text: started keeping a little notebook of what works in {hobby}
milestones.post: Taking notes now. Very serious business.

milestones.text: explained a finer point of {hobby} to a newcomer without fumbling
milestones.post: Heard myself explaining it and sounded like I knew.

milestones.text: taught a friend {hobby} from scratch over a few evenings
milestones.post: My first student. Proud teacher moment.

milestones.text: marked a full year of {hobby} with a long evening of it
milestones.post: One year. Celebrated the only way that made sense.

milestones.text: became the go-to for {hobby} questions among friends
milestones.post: Apparently I am the one to ask now. Odd.

milestones.text: kept a weekly {hobby} evening going for a whole season
milestones.post: A whole season of Thursdays. Nobody missed one.

milestones.text: got a sincere compliment about {hobby} from someone who has done it for decades
milestones.post: Decades of experience said well done. I am glowing.

milestones.text: had their best night of {hobby} ever, and knew it while it was happening
milestones.post: Best night yet. I knew it halfway through.

milestones.text: hosted an evening of {hobby} that people still talk about
milestones.post: They are still talking about it. So am I.

milestones.text: looked back at their first weeks of {hobby} and laughed at how far they had come
milestones.post: Remember when I was terrible? I do. Fondly.

milestones.text: started their own {hobby} group and kept it going for a year
milestones.post: A year of our little group. Did not see that coming.

milestones.text: was asked to help run a small {hobby} contest
milestones.post: Running the contest now, not just losing it.

milestones.text: lost their first proper game of {hobby} and laughed about it
milestones.post: Lost. Badly. Had a lovely time.

milestones.text: won their first game of {hobby} against someone who was really trying
milestones.post: An honest win. No mercy given. I won anyway.

milestones.text: won three games of {hobby} in a row on one evening
milestones.post: Three in a row. I am trying to stay humble.

milestones.text: won a game against the best player around, once
milestones.post: Once. Just once. It counts forever.

milestones.text: won a small {hobby} tournament outright
milestones.post: First place. I keep looking at it.

milestones.text: learned how the knight moves and immediately lost one
milestones.post: The horse goes in an L. Mine went straight off the board.

milestones.text: set up a chessboard correctly on the first try, white square on the right
milestones.post: White on the right. Queen on colour. Got it.

milestones.text: played a full game of chess without forgetting how a piece moves
milestones.post: Every piece moved legally. A personal best.

milestones.text: pulled off their first checkmate with a rook and king
milestones.post: King and rook, slow and sure. Mate.

milestones.text: stopped losing their queen in the first ten moves
milestones.post: Queen survived the opening. Big day for the queen.

milestones.text: learned a proper opening and played it all evening
milestones.post: I have an opening now. It has a name and everything.

milestones.text: spotted a fork two moves before it happened
milestones.post: Saw it coming. Forked them first.

milestones.text: played a whole game of chess blindfolded for fun, and lost gracefully
milestones.post: Played without looking. Lost. Still impressive, I say.

milestones.text: beat the oldest regular at the chess club
milestones.post: Beat the club's longest member. The handshake was firm.

milestones.text: played six people at once at the chess club and won four
milestones.post: Six boards, one of me. Four wins.

milestones.text: drew a game of chess against a visiting master
milestones.post: A draw with a master. I will be telling this for years.

milestones.text: solved their first chess puzzle book chapter without peeking
milestones.post: No peeking at the answers. Almost no peeking.

milestones.text: played their first chess game online against a stranger abroad
milestones.post: Played someone on the other side of the world. Lost, politely.

milestones.text: reached a respectable online chess rating
milestones.post: The number went up. I am pretending not to care.

milestones.text: played chess by letter with a distant friend, one move a week
milestones.post: Move fourteen came in the post today. Plotting.

milestones.text: won a game of chess at the castle hall in front of a small crowd
milestones.post: Watchers all round. Won anyway.

milestones.text: was asked to play chess with the lord of the manor and held their own
milestones.post: Played the lord. Did not lose too quickly.

milestones.text: learned chess from an old soldier at the inn
milestones.post: Taught by a veteran. Moves explained very loudly.

milestones.text: won the chess prize at the harvest fair
milestones.post: A ribbon for chess. Hanging it by the board.

milestones.text: entered their first rated chess tournament and finished in the top ten
milestones.post: Top ten. My knees are still shaking.

milestones.text: played chess against a clockwork automaton and lost in eight moves
milestones.post: Beaten by gears. Eight moves. Respect.

milestones.text: held their own at the chess table in a busy coffee house
milestones.post: Coffee house chess. Held my ground.

milestones.text: won the chess ladder at their club for a month
milestones.post: Top of the ladder. For now.

milestones.text: played their first game of go on a small nine-by-nine board
milestones.post: Small board, big confusion. Loved it.

milestones.text: learned what an eye is in go and why it matters
milestones.post: Two eyes and the group lives. Who knew.

milestones.text: kept a group alive in go for the first time
milestones.post: My stones lived. Every one of them.

milestones.text: moved up to the full nineteen-by-nineteen go board
milestones.post: Big board now. So many places to be wrong.

milestones.text: won a go game by more than ten points
milestones.post: Ten points ahead. I counted twice.

milestones.text: started reviewing their own go games afterwards
milestones.post: Replayed my game move by move. Found my mistakes. All of them.

milestones.text: earned their first official go rank at the club
milestones.post: I have a rank now. A real one.

milestones.text: played go against a visiting player from Seoul and held on
milestones.post: Lost by a little to someone very good. Delighted.

milestones.text: won their division at a regional go tournament
milestones.post: Division winner. Still processing.

milestones.text: reached single-digit kyu in go
milestones.post: Single digits. Years of stones for this.

milestones.text: finished a whole book of go life-and-death problems
milestones.post: Every problem in the book done. Some twice.

milestones.text: went to their first board game night and learned four new games
milestones.post: Four new games. My brain is full.

milestones.text: read a rulebook cover to cover before game night
milestones.post: I read the whole rulebook. Ask me anything.

milestones.text: won their first game at board game night
milestones.post: First win at game night. They were not ready.

milestones.text: bought their first big box game and taught it to friends
milestones.post: My own game. Taught it badly. Still fun.

milestones.text: ran their first tabletop role-playing session for a few friends
milestones.post: I ran the game. Nobody wandered off. Success.

milestones.text: learned a famously long strategy game and finished it in one evening
milestones.post: Four hours, one game, zero regrets.

milestones.text: became the person who explains the rules at game night
milestones.post: Rules person now. It is a sacred duty.

milestones.text: kept a role-playing campaign going for a whole year
milestones.post: One year of the same story. Our heroes live.

milestones.text: designed a small board game of their own and friends asked to play it again
milestones.post: They asked for a rematch. Of my game. My game.

milestones.text: won the café's seasonal board game league
milestones.post: League champion. The café gave me a tiny trophy.

milestones.text: stopped checking the rulebook every turn
milestones.post: Whole game, no rulebook. Growth.

milestones.text: learned to shuffle without spraying the deck across the floor
milestones.post: The cards stayed in my hands. Mostly.

milestones.text: learned the rules of whist from a kind neighbour
milestones.post: Whist. Learned it. Lost every trick. Very nice evening.

milestones.text: kept count of trumps through an entire hand
milestones.post: Counted every trump. Felt like a detective.

milestones.text: won their first hand of cribbage, pegs and all
milestones.post: Moved my peg home first. Tiny triumph.

milestones.text: learned to riffle shuffle and bridge the cards back together
milestones.post: The cascade shuffle. I have been practising for weeks.

milestones.text: partnered well enough at cards that nobody sighed
milestones.post: My partner did not sigh once. Huge.

milestones.text: won the evening at the card club two weeks running
milestones.post: Two weeks on top. The club is suspicious.

milestones.text: taught a table of newcomers a card game and kept them laughing
milestones.post: Taught a whole table. Everyone stayed.

milestones.text: won the card club's season trophy
milestones.post: Season trophy. The deck is retiring with honours.

milestones.text: made a grand slam at bridge, all thirteen tricks
milestones.post: All thirteen tricks. I need to sit down.

milestones.text: won a hand of poker on nerve alone at the saloon table, for matchsticks
milestones.post: Nothing in my hand. Won the matchsticks anyway.

milestones.text: held their own at a friendly card game on a long stagecoach ride
milestones.post: Cards across three bumpy states. Won two games.

milestones.text: was invited to make up a fourth at the parlour bridge table
milestones.post: Asked to make a fourth. I have arrived.

milestones.text: played cards on an airship deck without losing a single card to the wind
milestones.post: Fifty-two cards, one airship, no losses.

milestones.text: finished their first newspaper crossword, with a few guesses
milestones.post: Every square filled. Some of them correctly.

milestones.text: got their first crossword answer without any letters crossing it
milestones.post: Got one cold. No help. I felt clever.

milestones.text: finished the weekday crossword three days running
milestones.post: Three in a row. Breakfast has a purpose now.

milestones.text: started doing the crossword in pen
milestones.post: Pen now. No going back.

milestones.text: solved their first cryptic clue and understood why
milestones.post: A cryptic clue, solved and understood. Big morning.

milestones.text: finished the Saturday crossword before lunch
milestones.post: Saturday puzzle done before noon. Unheard of.

milestones.text: finished a whole cryptic crossword without a single hint
milestones.post: A full cryptic. No hints. I might frame it.

milestones.text: wrote a small crossword of their own for a friend
milestones.post: Made a crossword. My friend solved it. Mostly.

milestones.text: had a crossword they wrote printed in the local paper
milestones.post: My puzzle is in the paper. In print.

milestones.text: placed in the top ten at a crossword contest
milestones.post: Top ten. Fastest pencil in the room. Nearly.

milestones.text: kept up with the crossword craze all season and won a dictionary prize
milestones.post: Won a dictionary. Most fitting prize ever.

milestones.text: finished the daily crossword before their coffee went cold, timing it on the phone
milestones.post: Beat the coffee. Timer says so.

milestones.text: finished their first 500-piece jigsaw, missing one piece
milestones.post: 499 pieces. The last one is out there somewhere.

milestones.text: did all the edge pieces of a jigsaw first, like the experts say
milestones.post: Edges done. Middle is a mystery.

milestones.text: finished a 1,000-piece jigsaw in a single weekend
milestones.post: A thousand pieces. One weekend. Sore neck.

milestones.text: sorted a whole jigsaw by colour before starting, and it worked
milestones.post: Sorted into piles. It worked. I am a convert.

milestones.text: finished a jigsaw of nothing but sky
milestones.post: All sky. Every piece blue. Done.

milestones.text: glued and framed a finished jigsaw for the wall
milestones.post: Glued it down. Hung it up. Admire it.

milestones.text: finished a 2,000-piece jigsaw on the dining table over a month
milestones.post: Two thousand pieces. We ate in the kitchen for a month.

milestones.text: started a jigsaw swap with neighbours
milestones.post: Swapped puzzles with the street. Fresh boxes for all.

milestones.text: finished a 5,000-piece jigsaw, every piece accounted for
milestones.post: Five thousand. Every one. I need a lie down.

milestones.text: came second at a timed jigsaw contest
milestones.post: Second place at speed jigsaws. My hands are a blur.

milestones.text: finished a wooden jigsaw cut by hand, the old-fashioned kind
milestones.post: Hand-cut wooden puzzle. Every piece a little treasure.

milestones.text: hit the dartboard with every dart for a whole evening
milestones.post: Every dart hit the board. The wall is safe.

milestones.text: learned how to keep score at darts
milestones.post: Subtracting under pressure. Harder than the throwing.

milestones.text: hit their first double to finish a game of darts
milestones.post: Double sixteen to finish. Heard myself cheer.

milestones.text: bought their own set of darts
milestones.post: My own darts. They feel like mine already.

milestones.text: hit their first treble twenty
milestones.post: Treble twenty. Just the one. Still counts.

milestones.text: joined the pub darts team as a reserve
milestones.post: Reserve for the pub team. Ready when called.

milestones.text: threw a hundred with three darts
milestones.post: A ton. Three darts. The pub went quiet, then loud.

milestones.text: won a deciding leg for the pub darts team
milestones.post: Won the deciding leg. Team bought me a lemonade.

milestones.text: hit a 180 on league night
milestones.post: One hundred and eighty. Three in the treble.

milestones.text: won the pub's annual darts cup
milestones.post: Darts cup winner. Name on the board for a year.

milestones.text: finished a game of darts on the bull
milestones.post: Out on the bull. Felt like a film.

milestones.text: potted their first ball on purpose
milestones.post: Meant to do that. Honestly.

milestones.text: learned to hold a cue without the bridge collapsing
milestones.post: Hand bridge held firm. Shots still wobbly.

milestones.text: cleared three balls in a row at the pool table
milestones.post: Three in a row. Kept my head down.

milestones.text: stopped scratching the cue ball into the pocket
milestones.post: Cue ball stayed on the table all night.

milestones.text: made their first bank shot and called it beforehand
milestones.post: Called it. Banked it. Cannot stop smiling.

milestones.text: learned to put backspin on the cue ball
milestones.post: Backspin works. The ball came back like a dog.

milestones.text: ran the table at pool for the first time
milestones.post: Ran the table. Every ball. Me.

milestones.text: held the table for a whole evening against all comers
milestones.post: Winner stays on. I stayed on.

milestones.text: won the pool hall's monthly tournament
milestones.post: Monthly champion. The cue gets a polish.

milestones.text: made a century break at snooker
milestones.post: A century. A hundred points, one visit.

milestones.text: played billiards in the frontier hotel parlour and won a game
milestones.post: A game won on the old felt table in town.

milestones.text: held their own at the billiard table in a private members' club
milestones.post: Played in the members' room. Was not thrown out.

milestones.text: learned the rules of nine men's morris from the innkeeper
milestones.post: Nine pieces each. Lost all nine. Lovely evening.

milestones.text: threw their first game of hazard at the tavern and lost a single copper
milestones.post: One copper lost. Lesson learned. Cheap lesson.

milestones.text: carved a little set of dice of their own from bone-white wood
milestones.post: My own dice. They roll a bit crooked. I love them.

milestones.text: won their first game of tables against the miller
milestones.post: Beat the miller at tables. The miller wants a rematch.

milestones.text: learned hnefatafl and kept the king alive to the corner
milestones.post: Got the king to the corner. Ran out of breath cheering.

milestones.text: won three games of merels in one night at the inn
milestones.post: Three merels games. Three wins. The inn noticed.

milestones.text: learned to read the board at tables two moves ahead
milestones.post: Saw two moves ahead. Like weather sense.

milestones.text: was asked to teach the squire's children nine men's morris
milestones.post: Taught the squire's little ones. They beat me once.

milestones.text: won the hnefatafl board as a prize at the market fair
milestones.post: Won the board itself. Now it is mine.

milestones.text: won the midwinter games at the great hall
milestones.post: Midwinter champion. The hall cheered.

milestones.text: beat a travelling game-master at tables before the whole inn
milestones.post: Beat the wanderer. Whole inn watched.

milestones.text: won a game of dice against a talking raven, fair and square
milestones.post: The raven says it was luck. It was skill.

milestones.text: played tables with pilgrims on the road and won a loaf
milestones.post: Won a loaf of bread. Best prize yet.

milestones.text: won a first game against someone more experienced
milestones.post: Beat someone better. Once.

milestones.text: learned all the rules without asking twice
milestones.post: Know the rules now. All of them.

milestones.text: lost graciously and asked for a rematch
milestones.post: Lost. Rematch booked.

milestones.text: stopped making the same opening mistake
milestones.post: Same mistake? Not anymore.

milestones.text: played a whole evening of games
milestones.post: A whole evening of games.

milestones.text: kept score correctly for a whole night
milestones.post: Kept the score. Nobody argued.

milestones.text: won a game by careful play rather than luck
milestones.post: Won it fair and square.

milestones.text: learned a trick from watching an old hand
milestones.post: Stole a trick by watching.

milestones.text: set up a proper place to play at home
milestones.post: A proper spot to play.

milestones.text: won three games in a row
milestones.post: Three in a row!

milestones.text: beat a friend who usually wins
milestones.post: Beat the usual winner.

milestones.text: saw through the other player's plan in time
milestones.post: Saw it coming. Stopped it.

milestones.text: played a long game without losing focus
milestones.post: Long game, sharp all the way.

milestones.text: came back from far behind to win
milestones.post: From way behind to a win.

milestones.text: was asked to make up the numbers at a table of good players
milestones.post: Invited to the good table.

milestones.text: kept a calm face through a whole tense game
milestones.post: Poker face held.

milestones.text: learned a classic strategy and used it well
milestones.post: Classic move, used well.

milestones.text: won a game with a move nobody saw coming
milestones.post: Nobody saw it coming.

milestones.text: won a small tournament in town
milestones.post: Won the town tournament!

milestones.text: beat a well-known local player
milestones.post: Beat a local name.

milestones.text: taught a newcomer to play and gained a friend
milestones.post: Taught someone. Gained a friend.

milestones.text: played the best game of their life so far
milestones.post: Best game yet.

milestones.text: was given a nickname by the regulars
milestones.post: The regulars have a name for me now.

milestones.text: held their own at the best table in town
milestones.post: Held my own at the top table.

milestones.text: won a game that was talked about for days
milestones.post: People are still talking about that one.

milestones.text: went a whole season without a heavy loss
milestones.post: No heavy losses all season.

milestones.text: won the town championship
milestones.post: Town champion!

milestones.text: beat a visiting champion
milestones.post: Beat a visiting champion.

milestones.text: was asked to settle a dispute about the rules
milestones.post: Called in to settle the rules.

milestones.text: played several opponents in one evening and lost to none
milestones.post: Undefeated tonight.

milestones.text: won a prize worth keeping
milestones.post: A prize worth keeping.

milestones.text: had a game retold around town for weeks
milestones.post: Still being retold.

milestones.text: was challenged by players from the next town
milestones.post: Challengers from the next town.

milestones.text: won a long, close final
milestones.post: Close final. Won.

milestones.text: won the regional championship
milestones.post: Regional champion.

milestones.text: beat the best player anyone in town had ever seen
milestones.post: Beat the best anyone's seen.

milestones.text: was sought out by players travelling just for a game
milestones.post: People travel to play me now.

milestones.text: taught a student who went on to win too
milestones.post: My student won too!

milestones.text: played through a whole year unbeaten
milestones.post: A whole year unbeaten.

milestones.text: became the one to beat in town
milestones.post: The one to beat. Me.

milestones.text: won a famous game remembered for years
milestones.post: One for the history books.

milestones.text: was asked to teach the game to a grand family
milestones.post: Teaching a grand family.

milestones.text: finished a first game all the way through
milestones.post: Credits rolled!

milestones.text: beat a boss after a whole evening of tries
milestones.post: FINALLY.

milestones.text: finished a game on the hardest setting
milestones.post: Hardest setting, beaten.

milestones.text: set a personal best speedrun time
milestones.post: New personal best.

milestones.text: placed in an online tournament
milestones.post: Placed in a tournament!

milestones.text: built a first deck of their own
milestones.post: My first deck.

milestones.text: won a first game at a card shop night
milestones.post: First win at card night!

milestones.text: went undefeated at a local card night
milestones.post: Undefeated tonight.

milestones.text: made the top eight at a regional tournament
milestones.post: Top eight!

milestones.text: qualified for a national championship
milestones.post: Qualified for nationals!

sessions.text: Lost track of time completely.
Came home in a good mood about it.
Kept it light and had a laugh.
Stayed later than planned.
Thought about it all the way home.
Did not win much, but enjoyed every minute.
Played the same opponent three times and it was close every time.
Practised one thing over and over until it felt natural.
Ended the evening one game up.
Set the board up for tomorrow before bed.
Spent most of the evening on a single long game.
Got stuck on one corner for an age, then it all fell into place.
Filled in the last answer with a satisfied tap of the pen.
Found three edge pieces that had been hiding under the box lid.
Worked on their grouping until the darts landed close together.
Practised long shots on an empty table.
Played a few hands with whoever was around.
Learned a new game that someone brought along.
Rolled more sixes than anyone thought fair.
Went over an old game move by move afterwards.
Swapped tips with a regular between games.
